While the title designates the wholesome triad (*kusala-ttika*), the secondary literature provided in the dossier does not specifically analyze this seventh division, instead focusing on the opening *Kusalattika* of the *Tikapaṭṭhāna* (Patthana 1) or other compound triad configurations.
